sync.notConfigured: No sync server is set up. Everything stays on this device. (See the Supabase setup in DEPLOY.md)
sync.enableIntro: Your username and password are the key for linking other devices. We don't ask for any other personal information.
sync.enable: Create vault and turn on sync
sync.loginIntro: Link this device to the vault of an existing username. This device's data is merged, not overwritten.
sync.codeIntro: On a device that's already linked, go to Settings → Sync → “Link a device” to get a 6-digit code and QR. This device's data is merged, not overwritten.
sync.pairIntro: On the new device, choose “Link with a code” and enter this code or scan the QR. It works once, for 5 minutes.
sync.passwordIntro: Change the password of your username key. You'll need the current password. If you forgot it, use “New key”.
sync.rekeyIntro: Forgot your password? Create a new username and password for this vault; the old username key is removed. Linked devices stay linked.
sync.pendingWarn: Some changes haven't reached the server yet. If you log out now, your other devices won't get them.

missingImages.one: {n} photo not yet downloaded will disappear from this device after logout.
missingImages.other: {n} photos not yet downloaded will disappear from this device after logout.

sync.keepLocalDesc: After logout, everything stays on this device and you can keep working.
sync.wipeLocalDesc: Erases this device's maps, photos and sync state, and restores the starter examples. Your vault on the server is untouched.
sync.leaveList: This device will be removed from the vault's device list.
sync.reconnectCode: To reconnect, you'll need a link code from another device.
sync.reconnectId: To reconnect, just log in with your username.
sync.reconnectAny: To reconnect, log in with your username or get a link code from another device.
sync.logoutWipe: Log out and erase this device
sync.loggedOut: Logged out. Everything now stays on this device only.
sync.loggedOutOffline: Logged out. The server couldn't be reached, so this device may still be listed. Remove it from another device.
sync.deleteIntro: Deletes the vault and all maps, photos and keys on the server. Sync stops on every linked device. Data on this device stays. This can't be undone.
sync.deleted: All data on the server has been deleted.
sync.revoked: Another device unlinked this one, so you've been logged out. Data on this device is untouched.
sync.offIntro: With sync on, your maps and photos are saved to your vault (the server) and kept in step with your linked devices. With it off, every feature still works.
sync.waitingIntro: Choose whether to add this device's content to your account, or use your account's content only.
sync.removeConfirm: Unlink “{name}”? That device will no longer have access to the server data.
sync.restoreIntro: Backups kept on this device when you chose “Use account only”. Picking one adds it to your current content (undoable). They're deleted after 30 days.
sync.camera: Can't use the camera. Please type the code.

err.rateLimited: Please try again in a moment
err.samePassword: The new password is the same as the old one
err.captcha: The human check (CAPTCHA) failed. Please try again
err.anonDisabled: Anonymous sign-in is turned off on the server (see DEPLOY.md step 2)
err.signupDisabled: Sign-ups are turned off on the server (see DEPLOY.md step 2)
err.notConfirmed: A server setting is blocking sign-up (see “turn off confirmation” in DEPLOY.md step 2)
err.badCode: The code is wrong or has expired
err.tooManyAttempts: Too many tries. Please wait 10 minutes
err.lastKey: The last key can't be removed. Use Delete account instead
err.network: Can't reach the server. Check your internet connection or whether the server is paused
err.captchaLoad: Couldn't load the CAPTCHA (check your internet connection)
